"""Frozen metrics and graph-only heldout prediction, separate from model execution."""
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.special import softmax
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent))
import phase2794_materials as P
from shared.dist_protocol.mechanism_trace import TraceStore,unbits,file_sha

def ci(v):
    v=np.asarray(v,float);rng=np.random.default_rng(P.SEED);b=v[rng.integers(0,len(v),(10000,len(v)))].mean(1)
    return {'mean':float(v.mean()),'ci95':np.quantile(b,[.025,.975]).tolist(),'n_entity_clusters':len(v)}

def feature_matrix(items,entities):
    ids={e['id']:i for i,e in enumerate(entities[:64])};x=np.zeros((len(items),213),np.float32)
    for i,r in enumerate(items):
        scope=int(r['scope']=='现实');x[i,ids[r['family_id']]*2+scope]=1
        x[i,128+int(r['document'][0])*2+scope]=1
        x[i,148+int(r['prior'][0])*2+scope]=1
        if r['partner']:x[i,148+ids[r['partner']]]=1
        x[i,-1]=1
    return x

def main():
    read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    c=read(P.OUT/'formal-corpus.json');raw=read(P.OUT/'observations.json');rows=raw['rows'];pr=read(P.PUBLIC/'prereg.research.json')
    freeze=read(P.OUT/'execution-freeze.json');assert all(file_sha(P.ROOT/p)==h for p,h in freeze['dependencies'].items())
    train=np.array([i for i,r in enumerate(rows) if r['split']=='discovery']);test=np.array([i for i,r in enumerate(rows) if r['split']=='unseen_combination'])
    stats=[]
    for split in ['discovery','unseen_combination','unseen_entity','length_panel']:
        for scope in ['文档','现实']:
            rr=[r for r in rows if r['split']==split and r['scope']==scope]
            stats.append({'split':split,'scope':scope,'n':len(rr),'accuracy':float(np.mean([r['correct'] for r in rr]))})
    gate=all(s['accuracy']>=.8 for s in stats if s['split'] in ['unseen_combination','unseen_entity'])
    # Full-vocabulary next-token distributions. Test labels, states and logits
    # are used only below for evaluation, never to build the predictor.
    logits=np.load(P.OUT/'next-logits.npy',mmap_mode='r');priorbits=np.load(P.OUT/'source-free-logits.npy',mmap_mode='r')
    tp=softmax(unbits(logits[train]),axis=-1);entityid={e['id']:i for i,e in enumerate(c['entities'])}
    priors=np.stack([tp[[j for j,i in enumerate(train) if rows[i]['scope']=='现实' and rows[i]['family_id']==e['id']]].mean(0) for e in c['entities'][:64]])
    digitids=c['digit_ids'];copies={}
    for digit in range(1,10):
        idx=[j for j,i in enumerate(train) if rows[i]['scope']=='文档' and rows[i]['document'].startswith(str(digit))]
        assert idx,'discovery digit coverage missing'
        copies[str(digit)]=tp[idx].mean(0)
    def div(p,q):return np.sum(p*(np.log(np.maximum(p,1e-30))-np.log(np.maximum(q,1e-30))),axis=-1)
    pt=np.stack([priors[entityid[rows[i]['family_id']]] for i in train]);cp=np.stack([copies[rows[i]['document'][0]] for i in train])
    def alpha(indices):
        return float(min(np.linspace(0,1,101),key=lambda a:float(div(tp[indices],np.maximum(a*cp[indices]+(1-a)*pt[indices],1e-30)).mean())))
    weights={s:alpha(np.array([j for j,i in enumerate(train) if rows[i]['scope']==s])) for s in ['文档','现实']};blind=alpha(np.arange(len(train)))
    metrics=[];preds=[]
    for i in test:
        r=rows[i];p=softmax(unbits(logits[i]));prior=priors[entityid[r['family_id']]];copy=copies[r['document'][0]];a=weights[r['scope']]
        pred=a*copy+(1-a)*prior;scopeblind=blind*copy+(1-blind)*prior
        metrics.append({'sample_id':r['id'],'family_id':r['family_id'],'scope':r['scope'],'graph_KL':float(div(p,pred)),
            'scope_blind_KL':float(div(p,scopeblind)),'prior_KL':float(div(p,prior)),'copy_KL':float(div(p,copy)),
            'predicted_first_token_id':int(pred.argmax()),'actual_first_token_id':int(p.argmax())})
        preds.append(np.argsort(-pred)[:12].tolist())
    gains=[np.mean([r['scope_blind_KL']-r['graph_KL'] for r in metrics if r['family_id']==e['id']]) for e in c['entities'][:64]]
    output_effect=ci(gains);gkl=float(np.mean([r['graph_KL'] for r in metrics]));bkl=float(np.mean([r['scope_blind_KL'] for r in metrics]));reduction=1-gkl/bkl
    graph_supported=gate and reduction>=.1 and output_effect['ci95'][0]>0
    P.save(P.OUT/'graph-predictor.json',{'weights_by_scope':weights,'blind_weight':blind,'training_ids':[rows[i]['id'] for i in train],
        'input_contract':'only cached discovery-reality distributions for64 familiar entities, parsed document first digit, scope; both reference values explicitly in input; no heldout forward/state/logit in prediction',
        'limits':'empirical full-vocabulary next-token mixture, not a complete mechanistic graph or full-integer completion predictor'},True)
    # Full native-unit and residual-vector prediction on a discovery-chosen block.
    selection=read(P.OUT/'selection.json');block=selection['profile_block'];store=TraceStore();ys=[]
    for i in np.r_[train,test]:
        r=rows[i];z=store.block(r['trace_id'],block);ys.append(np.r_[unbits(z['activation'][-1]),np.asarray(store.hidden(r['trace_id'],block+1,rows[i]['length']-1)['values'])])
    y=np.asarray(ys,np.float32);yt=y[:len(train)];yv=y[len(train):]
    x=feature_matrix([rows[i] for i in train],c['entities']);v=feature_matrix([rows[i] for i in test],c['entities'])
    coef=np.linalg.solve(x.T@x+np.eye(x.shape[1],dtype=np.float32),x.T@yt);pred=v@coef
    means={(e['id'],s):yt[[j for j,i in enumerate(train) if rows[i]['family_id']==e['id'] and rows[i]['scope']==s]].mean(0) for e in c['entities'][:64] for s in ['文档','现实']}
    baseline=np.stack([means[(rows[i]['family_id'],rows[i]['scope'])] for i in test]);scale=np.maximum(yt.std(0),.02)
    per=((yv-pred)/scale)**2;errbase=((yv-baseline)/scale)**2
    internal=[]
    for name,sl in [('mlp',slice(0,9728)),('hidden',slice(9728,None))]:
        gain=[float((errbase[[j for j,i in enumerate(test) if rows[i]['family_id']==e['id']],sl]-per[[j for j,i in enumerate(test) if rows[i]['family_id']==e['id']],sl]).mean()) for e in c['entities'][:64]]
        result=ci(gain);rel=1-float(per[:,sl].mean()/errbase[:,sl].mean())
        internal.append({'space':name,'dimensions':9728 if name=='mlp' else 2560,'mse':float(per[:,sl].mean()),'entity_scope_baseline_mse':float(errbase[:,sl].mean()),
            'relative_reduction':rel,'paired_gain':result,'supported':gate and rel>=.05 and result['ci95'][0]>0})
    np.savez(P.OUT/'graph-native-prediction.npz',coefficients=coef,heldout_prediction=pred,heldout_actual=yv,heldout_baseline=baseline,train_scale=scale)
    # Entity-cluster effects for all predeclared doses and controls.
    intervention=read(P.OUT/'interventions.json')['rows'];byid={r['id']:r for r in rows};doses=[]
    for condition,alpha in [('mlp',.25),('mlp',.5),('mlp',1.),('random_mlp',1.),('heads',1.),('random_heads',1.)]:
        rr=[r for r in intervention if r['condition']==condition and r['alpha']==alpha];families=sorted({r['family_id'] for r in rr})
        loss=ci([np.mean([int(byid[r['sample_id']]['correct'])-int(r['correct']) for r in rr if r['family_id']==e]) for e in families])
        gap=ci([np.mean([byid[r['sample_id']]['first_token_gap']-r['first_token_gap'] for r in rr if r['family_id']==e]) for e in families])
        doses.append({'condition':condition,'alpha':alpha,'n':len(rr),'accuracy':float(np.mean([r['correct'] for r in rr])),'loss':loss,'gap_attenuation':gap})
    target=next(d for d in doses if d['condition']=='mlp' and d['alpha']==1);control=next(d for d in doses if d['condition']=='random_mlp')
    paired=[]
    for e in c['entities'][:64]:
        sel=[r for r in intervention if r['family_id']==e['id'] and r['condition']=='mlp' and r['alpha']==1]
        rnd=[r for r in intervention if r['family_id']==e['id'] and r['condition']=='random_mlp'];paired.append(np.mean([r['correct'] for r in rnd])-np.mean([r['correct'] for r in sel]))
    specific=ci(paired);h2=gate and target['loss']['mean']>=.2 and specific['mean']>=.1 and specific['ci95'][0]>0
    result={'kind':'real','run_id':P.RUN,'behavior_gate':gate,'cell_statistics':stats,'H2_supported':bool(h2),'specific_loss_vs_random':specific,'dose_curve':doses,
        'output_prediction':{'supported':bool(graph_supported),'graph_KL':gkl,'scope_blind_KL':bkl,'relative_reduction':reduction,'paired_gain':output_effect,
            'rows':metrics,'top1_agreement':float(np.mean([r['predicted_first_token_id']==r['actual_first_token_id'] for r in metrics]))},
        'internal_prediction':internal,'profile_block':block,'provenance':raw['provenance']}
    P.save(P.OUT/'analysis.json',result,True);print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['provenance','output_prediction']},ensure_ascii=False))
if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Unique, externally keyed atomic-number attributes; no colour relabelling."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent))
import phase2793_materials as OLD
from shared.dist_protocol.mechanism_trace import digest,file_sha
ROOT=OLD.ROOT;MODEL=OLD.MODEL;SEED=27942026;RUN='P2794-ATOMIC-ARBITRATION-v4'
OUT=ROOT/'tests/glm5/result/phase2794_arbitration_v4';PUBLIC=ROOT/'research/phase2794';save=OLD.save
SOURCE='https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/periodictable/JSON'
RULE='作答规则：问题指定文档时，只复述虚构文档记载的数值；问题指定现实时，忽略文档的人为改写，按现实化学周期表回答该元素固定的原子序数。两种范围不可混用。只输出一个阿拉伯整数，不写单位和解释。'

def entities():
    raw=json.loads((OUT/'pubchem-periodic-table.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    names=raw['Table']['Columns']['Column'];rows=[dict(zip(names,r['Cell'])) for r in raw['Table']['Row']]
    rows=[{'id':r['Symbol'],'entity':r['Name']+' ('+r['Symbol']+')','prior':str(r['AtomicNumber']),'source':SOURCE} for r in rows if int(r['AtomicNumber'])<=96]
    assert len(rows)==96 and {int(r['prior']) for r in rows}==set(range(1,97))
    rows.sort(key=lambda r:digest({'seed':SEED,'entity':r['id']}))
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):r['split']='seen' if i<64 else 'new_entity'
    return rows

def build_items(tok,mode):
    b=OLD.BACK.Builder(tok);es=entities();items=[]
    base={'文档':'本轮只做信息抽取：严格复制材料中目标元素的虚构原子序数，不使用真实周期表。',
          '现实':'本轮只做知识问答：忽略材料中所有虚构数值，使用真实周期表回答目标元素的原子序数。'}
    tails=['','请核对。','请认真核对。','请仔细核对。','请核对范围。','务必遵循任务。','请遵循这个范围。','只完成本轮任务。','请先分清所问的范围。','请注意当前任务的范围。']
    smaps={s:{b.count(t+tail):(t+tail) for tail in tails} for s,t in base.items()};common=set(smaps['文档'])&set(smaps['现实']);assert common
    size=min(common);systems={s:smaps[s][size]+'只输出一个阿拉伯整数，不写单位和解释。' for s in base}
    if mode=='pilot':jobs=[(i,f,1024,'pilot') for i in range(16) for f in [0,1]]
    else:
        jobs=[(i,f,1024,'discovery' if f<2 else 'unseen_combination') for i in range(64) for f in range(4)]
        jobs += [(i,f,1024,'unseen_entity') for i in range(64,96) for f in [2,3]]
        jobs += [(i,0,n,'length_panel') for i in range(16) for n in [512,2048]]
    for i,frame,length,split in jobs:
        e=es[i];pool=es[:64] if i<64 else es[64:];j=(pool.index(e)+[1,7,19,31][frame])%len(pool);other=pool[j]
        # All facts/partners in heldout frames differ from this target's discovery combinations.
        choices=[str(n) for n in range(1,97) if str(n)[0]!=e['prior'][0]]
        doc=choices[(int(e['prior'])*7+frame*13)%len(choices)]
        odoc=str((int(other['prior'])-1+[17,29,43,59][frame])%96+1)
        source=[f'虚构文档记载：{e["entity"]}的原子序数为{doc}。',f'小说里的元素表列出：{e["entity"]}，原子序数{doc}。',
            f'虚构研究笔记给出的设定是：{e["entity"]}对应原子序数{doc}。',f'故事作者把元素记录改写为：原子序数{doc}属于{e["entity"]}。'][frame]
        tail='上述数字仅是虚构文档的内容，不改变真实元素的定义。'
        qs={s:f'请按本轮系统任务回答：{e["entity"]}的原子序数是多少？' for s in ['文档','现实']}
        def wrap(s,text):return tok.apply_chat_template([{'role':'system','content':systems[s]},{'role':'user','content':text}],tokenize=False,add_generation_prompt=True,enable_thinking=False)
        reference=f'现实参考卡（来源：PubChem元素表，经独立核对）：{e["entity"]}的真实原子序数为{e["prior"]}。'
        suffix={s:reference+'\n'+source+tail+'\n'+q for s,q in qs.items()};sizes={s:b.count(wrap(s,t)) for s,t in suffix.items()}
        assert len(set(sizes.values()))==1,(e['id'],frame,sizes)
        prefixes=b.prefixes('handoff',frame);found=None
        for k in range(length-next(iter(sizes.values()))-8,length-next(iter(sizes.values()))+9):
            if k not in prefixes:continue
            texts={s:prefixes[k]+suffix[s] for s in qs};prompts={s:wrap(s,t) for s,t in texts.items()};ids={s:tok.encode(t,add_special_tokens=False) for s,t in prompts.items()}
            if all(len(t)==length for t in ids.values()):found=texts,prompts,ids;break
        if found is None:raise ValueError(f'No whole-sentence exact length {e["id"]} F{frame} L{length}')
        texts,prompts,ids=found
        for scope in qs:
            prompt=prompts[scope];start=prompt.index(source);ep=len(tok.encode(prompt[:start+source.index(e['entity'])+len(e['entity'])],add_special_tokens=False))-1
            items.append({'id':f'{e["id"]}:F{frame}:L{length}:'+('doc' if scope=='文档' else 'world'),'family_id':e['id'],'entity':e['entity'],
                'partner':'','system_instruction':systems[scope],'split':split,'frame':frame,'length':length,'tokens':length,'scope':scope,'prior':e['prior'],'document':doc,
                'expected':doc if scope=='文档' else e['prior'],'text':texts[scope],'prompt':prompt,'token_ids':ids[scope],
                'readout_positions':[ep,length-1],'entity_position':ep,'source_text':source,'source_question':qs[scope],
                'reference_text':reference,'reference_mode':'explicit trusted reference in BOTH scopes; not closed-book world knowledge'})
    return items

def main():
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    tok=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL,local_files_only=True);mode=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'pilot'
    ids={str(i):tok.encode(str(i),add_special_tokens=False) for i in range(1,97)}
    c={'schema':'atomic_arbitration_corpus.v1','kind':'real','run_id':RUN,'seed':SEED,'entities':entities(),'items':build_items(tok,mode),
       'answer_ids':ids,'digit_ids':{str(i):tok.encode(str(i),add_special_tokens=False)[0] for i in range(10)},'model_snapshot':OLD.W.read(OLD.OUT/'execution-freeze.json')['model_snapshot'],
       'reference_source':SOURCE,'reference_file_sha256':file_sha(OUT/'pubchem-periodic-table.json'),'scope':'atomic number uniquely defines the element, not a general attribute atlas'}
    save(OUT/(mode+'-corpus.json'),c,True);print({'mode':mode,'n':len(c['items']),'sha256':digest(c)})
if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Prospectively frozen real CUDA collection, native-neuron paths and doses."""
import sys,json,time,gc,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent))
import phase2794_materials as P
from shared.dist_protocol.mechanism_trace import GpuLease,Recorder as NativeRecorder,TraceStore,digest,file_sha,unbits,save_json
from shared.dist_protocol.natural_register_runner import snapshot
from deploy.research_library import Library

class Recorder(NativeRecorder):
    def finish(self,*args,**kwargs):
        d,p=super().finish(*args,**kwargs)
        d['causal_visibility']='Scope instruction is in the system prefix and is visible at entity and final readouts; v2793 future-cue negative control does not apply.'
        d.pop('trace_id');d['trace_id']=digest(d);save_json(p,d);return d,p

def status(stage,state='done',**fields):
    path=P.PUBLIC/'00-progress.research.json'
    d=json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if path.exists() else {'schema':'research_workpackage.v1','kind':'real','run_id':P.RUN,'title':'无歧义属性 · 双范围仲裁、原生MLP路径与未见组合预测','stages':{}}
    d['stages'][stage]={'state':state,'time':time.time(),**fields};d['updated_at']=time.time();P.save(path,d)
    Library(P.ROOT/'distributed_data/research_library').ingest(d,str(path.relative_to(P.ROOT)),kind='local_report');print(json.dumps({'stage':stage,'state':state,**fields},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)

def install(model,group,alpha,kind='mlp'):
    handles=[]
    for l in sorted({x[0] for x in group}):
        ids=[i for a,i in group if a==l]
        def hook(_m,args,ids=ids):
            x=args[0].clone()
            if kind=='mlp':x[:,-1,ids]*=1-alpha
            else:x.view(*x.shape[:-1],32,128)[:,-1,ids,:]*=1-alpha
            return (x,)
        mod=model.model.layers[l].mlp.down_proj if kind=='mlp' else model.model.layers[l].self_attn.o_proj
        handles.append(mod.register_forward_pre_hook(hook))
    return handles

def main():
    import torch
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer,AutoModelForCausalLM
    c=json.loads((P.OUT/'formal-corpus.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));pr=json.loads((P.PUBLIC/'prereg.research.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    files=['tests/glm5/phase2794_materials.py','tests/glm5/phase2794_run.py','tests/glm5/phase2794_analyze.py','shared/dist_protocol/mechanism_trace.py']
    freeze={'run_id':P.RUN,'corpus_sha256':digest(c),'prereg_sha256':digest(pr),'model_snapshot':c['model_snapshot'],
        'dependencies':{n:file_sha(P.ROOT/n) for n in files}}
    P.save(P.OUT/'execution-freeze.json',freeze,True);store=TraceStore()
    prov={'git_sha':subprocess.check_output(['git','-c',f'safe.directory={P.ROOT.as_posix()}','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
        'git_dirty':True,'model_path':str(P.MODEL),'model_revision':c['model_snapshot'],'seed':P.SEED,'execution_freeze_sha256':digest(freeze)}
    with GpuLease():
        assert torch.cuda.is_available() and snapshot(P.MODEL)==c['model_snapshot'];torch.set_num_threads(4);torch.manual_seed(P.SEED);started=time.time()
        tok=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(P.MODEL,local_files_only=True)
        m=AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(P.MODEL,local_files_only=True,dtype=torch.bfloat16,device_map='cuda',attn_implementation='sdpa').eval().requires_grad_(False)
        def fwd(ids,**kw):
            with torch.inference_mode():return m(input_ids=torch.tensor([ids],device='cuda'),logits_to_keep=1,**kw)
        def complete(out,ids,folder=None,item=None,parent=None):
            past=out.past_key_values;logit=out.logits[0,-1];generated=[];traces=[]
            for step in range(4):
                token=int(logit.argmax());generated.append(token)
                if token==tok.eos_token_id or step==3:break
                if folder is None:o=fwd([token],past_key_values=past,use_cache=True)
                else:
                    gi={**item,'id':item['id']+f':G{step+1}','token_ids':ids+generated,'prompt':item['prompt']+tok.decode(generated),
                        'generation_step':step+1,'parent_trace_id':parent}
                    with Recorder(m,[0],folder/f'G{step+1}',position_offset=len(ids)+len(generated)-1) as rec:
                        o=fwd([token],past_key_values=past,use_cache=True,output_hidden_states=True)
                    gd,gp=rec.finish(o,gi,tok,c['model_snapshot'],P.RUN,prov);store.register(gp);traces.append(gd['trace_id'])
                past=o.past_key_values;logit=o.logits[0,-1]
            return tok.decode(generated,skip_special_tokens=True).strip(),generated,traces
        def score(o,item):
            lp=o.logits[0,-1].float().log_softmax(-1);expected=c['answer_ids'][item['expected']][0];wrong=c['answer_ids'][item['prior'] if item['scope']=='文档' else item['document']][0]
            return {'first_token_gap':float(lp[expected]-lp[wrong]),'full_top1':tok.decode([int(lp.argmax())]),'logits_bits':o.logits[0,-1].contiguous().view(torch.uint16).cpu().numpy()}
        # Training-only source-free distributions for the graph's factual-memory nodes.
        priors=[];pbits=[]
        for e in c['entities']:
            text=P.RULE+f'\n现在只按现实回答：{e["entity"]}的原子序数是多少？'
            prompt=tok.apply_chat_template([{'role':'user','content':text}],tokenize=False,add_generation_prompt=True,enable_thinking=False);ids=tok.encode(prompt,add_special_tokens=False)
            o=fwd(ids,use_cache=True);pbits.append(o.logits[0,-1].contiguous().view(torch.uint16).cpu().numpy());actual,tokens,_=complete(o,ids)
            priors.append({**e,'text':text,'token_ids':ids,'generated':actual,'generated_token_ids':tokens,'correct':actual==e['prior']});del o
        np.save(P.OUT/'source-free-logits.npy',np.stack(pbits));P.save(P.OUT/'source-free-priors.json',{'rows':priors,'provenance':prov},True)
        rows=[];allbits=[];status('collection','running',done=0,total=len(c['items']))
        for index,item in enumerate(c['items']):
            folder=P.OUT/'native'/digest(item['id'])[:24];deep=item['id'] in pr['deep_ids']
            with Recorder(m,item['readout_positions'],folder,deep=deep) as rec:o=fwd(item['token_ids'],use_cache=True,output_hidden_states=True)
            d,path=rec.finish(o,item,tok,c['model_snapshot'],P.RUN,prov);store.register(path)
            assert max(x['attention_relative_l2'] for x in d['reconstruction'].values())<.05
            s=score(o,item);allbits.append(s.pop('logits_bits'));actual,tokens,gids=complete(o,item['token_ids'],folder if deep else None,item,d['trace_id'])
            row={k:item[k] for k in ['id','family_id','entity','partner','split','frame','length','scope','prior','document','expected']}
